_provenance: NYC traffic-accident CAR data, contiguous sub-map (500 tracts, 1301 induced undirected edges). Source: posteriordb data set `traffic_accident_nyc` (posterior `traffic_accident_nyc-bym2_offset_only`), file posterior_database/data/data/traffic_accident_nyc.json.zip from the local posteriordb checkout at /mnt/sbrantq/probprog/posteriordb, which carries N=1921 tracts, N_edges=5461 undirected adjacency edges (1-based node1/node2 lists), observed accident counts y and exposure E. Sub-map rule: deterministic breadth-first search from tract 0 (0-based), neighbours expanded in ascending node-id order, stopped at 500 distinct tracts; ids sorted ascending, induced subgraph kept. y and E are the observed values, unmodified; nothing is simulated. Same source and same rule as nyc_traffic_submap.json (the n=250 row of the SICM ablation figure), only the stopping size differs. Built by benchmark/probprog/ablation/sicm_roster/sweep_2026-09-10/build_nyc_submap_sized.py on 2026-09-10. Harness-format file: Q_inv, log_E and Y are produced by models/car_spatial.py's `nyc_traffic` branch arithmetic (Q = rho (D - W) + (1 - rho) I with rho=0.99, Q_inv symmetrised and jittered by 1e-6 I, log_E = log E), serialised in the exact shape pplbench's SubprocessInference._serialize_data emits. init_params = CARSpatial.generate_init_params(1396133, n=500), the trial seed pplbench derives from the ablation config's model seed 12345 and the seed run_frozen_batch.sh uses.
